title: U.S. Tech Selloff Met With Asian Market-Stability Measures
summary: U.S. tech stocks sold off on Friday, with the Nasdaq down 5.28% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index nearly 11%. Mainland China, South Korea, and Taiwan moved to stabilize their markets, including a cut in mainland China&\#x27;s minimum margin-financing ratio to 80%.
